boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost activities and destinations in Bethlehem, with eligibility and scheduling notes included where applicable.

cards.title: Join Fitness in the Garden
cards.subtitle: Bethlehem Rose Garden
cards.notes: Register for a monthly outdoor class, complete the required waiver, and use the provided equipment or bring a mat. Check the seasonal schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A city-run outdoor fitness class at the Rose Garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Bethlehem identifies Fitness in the Garden as a free program for all, held monthly from April through September.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; registration and a waiver are required. The city recommends the program for ages 16 and older; minors need a parent or guardian.

cards.title: Walk Monocacy Way on Trail Tuesday
cards.subtitle: Meet at Memorial Pool, 259 Illick's Mill Road
cards.notes: Join the scheduled guided walk at the Memorial Pool meeting point. Review the activity topic and complete the city waiver before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A guided Trail Tuesday walk on Monocacy Way.
cards.evidence_claim: The city lists a Trail Tuesday walk on the Monocacy Way Trail and states Trail Tuesday is free for all residents.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal first-Tuesday program, April through October; waiver required. The city specifies it is free for residents, and minors need a parent or guardian.

cards.title: Take a D&L Trail Tuesday outing
cards.subtitle: Meet at the Ice House, 56 River Street
cards.notes: Choose a listed walk or bike ride, meet at the Ice House, and bring a helmet if joining a bike activity. Confirm the current schedule beforehand.
cards.short_summary: A city-led walk, ride, or history outing on the D&L Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The city schedules Trail Tuesday birdwatching, bike, and history activities on the D&L Trail and states the program is free for all residents.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal first-Tuesday program, April through October; waiver required. The city specifies it is free for residents; helmets are required on bike rides.

cards.title: Walk the South Bethlehem Greenway
cards.subtitle: Meet at Harmony Pavilion on the Greenway
cards.notes: Use the Harmony Pavilion meeting point between Webster and Taylor streets for the scheduled guided walk, then follow the city-led route at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A guided September Trail Tuesday walk on the Greenway.
cards.evidence_claim: The city lists a Trail Tuesday walk on the South Bethlehem Greenway and states Trail Tuesday is free for all residents.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal first-Tuesday program; waiver required. The city specifies it is free for residents, and minors need a parent or guardian.

cards.title: Watch or ride at Bethlehem Skateplaza
cards.subtitle: South Bethlehem Greenway
cards.notes: Bring a skateboard, BMX bike, or inline skates if you ride; otherwise use the plaza as a daylight spot to watch and spend time outdoors.
cards.short_summary: A free public skateplaza integrated with the South Bethlehem Greenway.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Bethlehem states that Bethlehem Skateplaza is a public park and is free.
cards.access_notes: Open dawn to dusk according to the city. Bikes, skateboards, and inline skates are permitted; watching is also described as a use of the space.

cards.title: Record something in Studio 11
cards.subtitle: Bethlehem Area Public Library Main Library
cards.notes: Reserve the self-serve recording studio, bring a USB drive or cloud-storage access for files, and plan your session within Main Library hours.
cards.short_summary: A free recording studio resource for BAPL members.
cards.evidence_claim: Bethlehem Area Public Library states that Studio 11 is a free resource for library members.
cards.access_notes: Library membership is required; the studio is self-serve and uses Main Library hours. Save work to cloud storage or a USB drive.

cards.title: Attend a BAPL Coolidge program
cards.subtitle: BAPL Coolidge, 2740 Fifth Street
cards.notes: Check the library's event listing, select an all-ages program, and arrive during the Coolidge building's posted public hours for a no-cost activity.
cards.short_summary: Free, all-ages programming at BAPL's Coolidge location.
cards.evidence_claim: Bethlehem Area Public Library says BAPL Coolidge hosts free library programs for all ages.
cards.access_notes: Programs vary by calendar. Posted building hours are Tuesday through Thursday and the second Saturday of each month.

cards.title: Visit the Moravian Museum on Free Sunday
cards.subtitle: 66 West Church Street
cards.notes: Choose an eligible first Sunday, reserve ahead if attending the family craft, and explore the museum alongside the scheduled hands-on activity.
cards.short_summary: Free-Sunday museum access with a family craft activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Bethlehem Museums & Sites offers complimentary admission to the Moravian Museum of Bethlehem on designated Free Sundays.
cards.access_notes: Free Sundays run on the first Sunday of February through November, except April's second Sunday. Advance registration for the family craft is requested and limited to families attending with children.

cards.title: Visit Kemerer on Free Sunday
cards.subtitle: 427 North New Street
cards.notes: Plan for an eligible Free Sunday, reserve ahead when joining the family craft, and make time for both the museum galleries and the activity.
cards.short_summary: A designated free-admission Sunday at Kemerer Museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Bethlehem Museums & Sites offers complimentary admission to the Kemerer Museum of Decorative Arts on designated Free Sundays.
cards.access_notes: Free Sundays run on the first Sunday of February through November, except April's second Sunday. Advance registration for the family craft is requested and limited to families attending with children.

cards.title: See the Grist Miller's House on Free Sunday
cards.subtitle: 457 Old York Road
cards.notes: Select a Free Sunday date, reserve ahead if your family will take part in the craft, and combine the restored house visit with the scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic house included in free Sunday admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Bethlehem Museums & Sites includes the 1782 / 1834 Grist Miller's House in its complimentary-admission Free Sundays.
cards.access_notes: Free Sundays run on the first Sunday of February through November, except April's second Sunday. Advance registration for the family craft is requested and limited to families attending with children.

warnings: Several city programs are designated free specifically for City of Bethlehem residents; confirm residency eligibility before registering.
Historic Bethlehem's Free Sunday family craft reservations are limited to families attending with children.
